title: The Elephant Named Ladyface: a past life story

  • Kuruṅgavagga The Four-horned Antelope

6. Mahiḷāmukhajātaka The Elephant Named Ladyface: a past life story

“Purāṇacorāna vaco nisamma, Before, hearing the speech of the bandits, Mahiḷāmukho pothayamanvacārī; Ladyface went on a rampage. Susaññatānañhi vaco nisamma, But hearing the speech of the well-restrained, Gajuttamo sabbaguṇesu aṭṭhā”ti. the supreme elephant is established in all good qualities.

Mahiḷāmukhajātakaṁ chaṭṭhaṁ.
